headline: Salman Khan to open final season of 'Koffee With Karan]
summary: Filmmaker Karan Johar announces the ninth and last season of his celebrity chat show, with Salman Khan as the first guest.
details: Salman Khan will be the first guest on the ninth and final season of filmmaker Karan Johar’s celebrity chat show, 'Koffee With Karan'.
Johar shared a promo on Instagram confirming Salman’s appearance, with the season set to stream from October 14 onwards on The Peacock Hub on JioHotstar.
The decision to end the show after 22 years is personal, as Johar intends to devote more time to directing films and telling more stories in the next decade of his career.
Johar described the decision as emotional, noting that the show has been a large part of his identity and synonymous with candid celebrity conversations and controversies.
The show first debuted on Star World in 2004, with Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol appearing as the first guests.
Over the years, the show featured iconic stars like Amitabh Bachchan, Abhishek Bachchan, and Aishwarya Rai, running across multiple platforms including Star World and Hotstar.
caption:
After 22 years, the iconic 'Koffee With Karan' is coming to an end. Salman Khan will lead the final season.

Salman Khan will be the first guest on the ninth and final season of filmmaker Karan Johar’s celebrity chat show, 'Koffee With Karan'.

Johar shared a promo on Instagram confirming Salman’s appearance, with the season set to stream from October 14 onwards on The Peacock Hub on JioHotstar.

The decision to end the show after 22 years is personal, as Johar intends to devote more time to directing films and telling more stories in the next decade of his career.

Johar described the decision as emotional, noting that the show has been a large part of his identity and synonymous with candid celebrity conversations and controversies.

The show first debuted on Star World in 2004, with Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol appearing as the first guests.

Over the years, the show featured iconic stars like Amitabh Bachchan, Abhishek Bachchan, and Aishwarya Rai, running across multiple platforms including Star World and Hotstar.

headline_marked: 21 hours: [[CUET Vice-Chancellor blockaded]] in office by protesting students
headline: 21 hours: CUET Vice-Chancellor blockaded in office by protesting students
summary: Prof Sk Shariful Alam and 11 others remain locked inside the administrative building without water or electricity as students demand the VC's resignation.
details: Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) Vice-Chancellor Prof Sk Shariful Alam and 11 others have been locked inside the VC's office for over 21 hours.
Protesting students padlocked the main gate of the administrative building at 12:30 pm on Monday, trapping the VC, CUET branch Chhatra Dal leaders, and alumni.
The trapped individuals are suffering as all utility services, including water and electricity, have been shut down. Many have run out of mobile phone battery, losing contact with their families.
During the night, a CUET alumnus, Engineer Shahriar, had to be evacuated by ambulance after suffering from high blood pressure and breathing difficulties.
Students are demanding the resignation of the current Vice-Chancellor and the reinstatement of former VC Prof Abu Sadat Muhammad Sayem.
The protesters stated that the building will only be unlocked if the current VC resigns and leaves the campus.
Raozan Upazila Assistant Commissioner (Land) Anching Marma visited the site on Monday night and requested students to restore water and electricity for those inside.
Vice-Chancellor Shariful reported that he is in contact with the administration to arrange an exit from the building.
caption:
Locked in for 21 hours without water or electricity. CUET students have blockaded their Vice-Chancellor in his own office.

Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) Vice-Chancellor Prof Sk Shariful Alam and 11 others have been locked inside the VC's office for over 21 hours.

Protesting students padlocked the main gate of the administrative building at 12:30 pm on Monday, trapping the VC, CUET branch Chhatra Dal leaders, and alumni.

The trapped individuals are suffering as all utility services, including water and electricity, have been shut down. Many have run out of mobile phone battery, losing contact with their families.

During the night, a CUET alumnus, Engineer Shahriar, had to be evacuated by ambulance after suffering from high blood pressure and breathing difficulties.

Students are demanding the resignation of the current Vice-Chancellor and the reinstatement of former VC Prof Abu Sadat Muhammad Sayem.

The protesters stated that the building will only be unlocked if the current VC resigns and leaves the campus.

Raozan Upazila Assistant Commissioner (Land) Anching Marma visited the site on Monday night and requested students to restore water and electricity for those inside.

Vice-Chancellor Shariful reported that he is in contact with the administration to arrange an exit from the building.
